title: [2026-10-26-footnotes-and-endnotes] 01 · Notes layers: footnotes, endnotes, critical apparatus

plan.text: Build private, interpretation-free reference file of copied reading notes and citations
plan.note: Delivered 2026-11-27 (loop PR, journal-handwritten-web #17): studio/data/reading-notes.json exists as a schema-valid notes-v1 backup envelope. It holds zero records: no transcribed reading notes exist in the repository to copy into it (the author's copied reading notes live in the handwritten journal pages, which are not transcribed as text anywhere in the repo; "possible echoes (open item 6)" is the borrowed-line credit decision from #55, not citations). Nothing invented. The author fills it by writing notes in the studio Notes tab and exporting; see reading-notes.md.

title: [2026-10-26-footnotes-and-endnotes] 02 · Personal reflection notes and dual dating

plan.text: Dual-date every note (poem date + note date), visible on tap
plan.note: Delivered 2026-11-27 (loop PR, journal-handwritten-web #18): the sidecar already carried poemDate + noteDate; the public reader now shows both on tap (site/notes-layer.mjs dualDateText, used by the reveal panel and the apparatus meta) — recorded as the value, 'c. <value>' for approximate, 'undated' for unknown, never a guessed year. Finding: no poem dates are recoverable from the repo (site/data/j.json: 156/156 'd': null; no date keys in j.json or review.json; poem-records.json dates are publish exposures), so every poemDate stays {unknown, null} until the author supplies one.

plan.text: Version notes so reflections can accrue over time
plan.note: Delivered 2026-11-27 (loop PR, journal-handwritten-web #18): accrual is the model's append-only parents chain (a later reflection is a new revision whose parents lists the prior revisionId; the first revision stays byte-identical), proven by new tests in tests/test_notes_model.mjs; the workbench already shows a reflection's revision history. No reflection content was seeded — no author reflection text exists in-repo.

plan.text: Place reflections in endnotes; keep footnotes short and word/line-anchored
plan.note: Delivered 2026-11-27 (loop PR, journal-handwritten-web #18): a cleared reflection (private kind 'reflection') now projects to the public sidecar as kind 'endnote' (studio/notes-model.mjs — the sidecar carries only footnote/endnote/critical-note, so a verbatim 'reflection' kind was rejected by both sidecar validators and could never reach the reader), numbered across the series at render and shown in the reveal panel; footnotes stay short and anchored. Proven end to end by new tests in tests/test_notes_layer.mjs. No reflection content was seeded.

plan.text: Decide whether reflections on new poems are written immediately or after a deliberate gap
plan.note: Default recorded 2026-11-27 (loop PR, journal-handwritten-web #18, author-overridable): new-poem reflections are written after a deliberate gap, not same-day; old-poem (retrospective) reflections come first. The decision itself is still the author's.
